author: AsianGamer1994
quote:
Clearly, a bunch of toxic GTA crybabies are review-bombing The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, giving it negative reviews and ridiculously low scores without even playing the game.

Ocarina of Time is an absolute masterpiece. It has stood the test of time for decades and has been a life-changing experience for countless gamers. If you genuinely want to criticize it, at least play it yourself and experience what makes it so special before judging it.Otherwise, you’re not reviewing the game; you’re just spamming negative scores out of spite. You can love GTA without tearing down Zelda. 

Real gamers appreciate great games instead of trying to ruin the experience for everyone else.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: AsianGamer1994
quote: You can enjoy both GTA and Zelda at the same time but a bunch of toxic GTA crybabies review-bombing The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time instead of focusing on their own game. I have GTA 6 myself and a DualSense controller with my own money, so this isn’t about hating GTA. It’s about how toxic some of its fanboys can be. The way they constantly try to pick fights with other gaming communities says more about them than it does about the games they claim to love. You can love GTA without tearing down Zelda. You can be excited about GTA 6 without trying to invalidate another franchise’s legacy. Gaming is supposed to be about enjoying the games we love, not turning everything into a pointless console war.
